wallet.negative_paths.info: Withdraw writes balance minus amount with no funds check (service/transfer.go:75), so a withdrawal larger than the balance goes negative; only transfer checks funds (service/transfer.go:29).

wallet.unit.info: Minor units in a bigint column (migrations/0001_wallets.sql:6) with no currency anywhere, so one fixed currency is implied and a wallet holds one unit.

wallet.history_truth.info: Best-effort: deposit writes the balance first (service/transfer.go:58) and the history row after it with nothing joining them (service/transfer.go:61), transfers and withdrawals write no history, and no job compares the two.

wallet.in_flight_money.info: There is no reserved concept: a transfer debits the source (service/transfer.go:33) before calling Settle (service/transfer.go:37), and if Settle fails the debit stays while the credit never happens.

wallet.replayable_credits.info: Deposit (service/transfer.go:44) takes a caller tracking number but never checks it (service/transfer.go:62), so a replayed deposit credits twice.

wallet.other_writers.info: unknown: nothing in this repository writes wallets.balance outside UpdateBalance (repo/wallet.go:34); only the team can say whether an admin tool or another service does.

payout.return_window.info: unknown: Withdraw only lowers the balance (service/transfer.go:75); the money leaves through a system that is not in this repository.

payout.return_handling.info: unknown: nothing in this repository credits a wallet back after a withdrawal (service/transfer.go:66).

payout.destination_snapshot.info: Not applicable: Withdraw takes no destination account (api/server.go:20).

payout.duplicate_rejection.info: Not safe: Withdraw takes no request id (api/server.go:20), so a re-submission debits again.

payout.gross_or_net.info: Not applicable: withdraw charges no fee (service/transfer.go:66), and TransferInput.Fee is accepted but never applied (domain/wallet.go:61).

BALANCE-LIMIT-ENFORCED.limit_exists.info: A maximum balance per wallet type from settings.max_balance (repo/wallet.go:52), checked on deposit only (service/transfer.go:54), not when a transfer credits a wallet (service/transfer.go:41).

BALANCE-LIMIT-ENFORCED.checked_atomicall.info: The limit is read (service/transfer.go:50) and compared in Go (service/transfer.go:54) before a separate UPDATE (service/transfer.go:58).

BALANCE-NEVER-NEGATIVE.guard_is_atomic.info: Transfer reads the balance (service/transfer.go:20) and checks it in Go (service/transfer.go:29) before a separate write (service/transfer.go:33); withdraw has no check (service/transfer.go:75).

CONSERVATION-UNDER-CONCURRENCY.invariant.info: The sum of the two wallets' balances must be the same before and after any set of transfers between them (service/transfer.go:33, service/transfer.go:41).

CURRENCY-MIXING-REFUSED.can_mix.info: Not applicable: there is no currency anywhere (domain/wallet.go:5), so one currency is implied.

DOUBLE-ENTRY-SUMS-TO-ZERO.enforced_outsi.info: No CHECK or trigger exists (migrations/0001_wallets.sql:1), and the two legs of a transfer are separate writes (service/transfer.go:33, service/transfer.go:41).

FAILURE-IS-NOT-TERMINAL.retry_entry.info: Not applicable: wallets have no failed state (domain/wallet.go:13).

FINAL-STATE-IS-FINAL.exceptions.info: StatusDeleted should have no way out, but EnableWallet sets enable with no status check, so a deleted wallet can be re-enabled (service/transfer.go:84).

IDEM-CONCURRENT.loser_behaviour.info: It should get a conflict or the first result; today both deposits run, because the tracking number is never checked (service/transfer.go:62).

IDEM-CRASH-AT-STEP.recovery.info: Nothing: a transfer that fails after the debit (service/transfer.go:33) keeps it, and no job or retry path finishes or reverses it.

IDEM-PAYLOAD-MISMATCH.rejects.info: That is the rule; the code never reads the tracking number back, so it compares nothing (service/transfer.go:62).

IDEM-REPLAY.stores_result.info: Nothing is stored against the tracking number; a repeated deposit runs again (service/transfer.go:44).

IDEM-REPLAY.replays_failures.info: A failed deposit is only returned (service/transfer.go:58), so a retry starts over.

ILLEGAL-TRANSITION-REFUSED.enforced_wher.info: EnableWallet and DeleteWallet set status with no check of the current one (service/transfer.go:84, service/transfer.go:93), and the column has no CHECK (migrations/0001_wallets.sql:7).

LEDGER-OUTSIDE-CALLER-TRANSACTION.shares.info: Atomic opens a transaction but runs fn on the plain *sql.DB (repo/wallet.go:59, repo/wallet.go:63), so every write is outside it.

MINOR-UNIT-CONVERSION.boundaries.info: None: there is no currency and no conversion; amounts are already integers (domain/wallet.go:5).

ORPHANED-AUTHORIZATION.expiry.info: Not applicable: there are no authorizations or holds in this repository.

RECONCILER-IS-IDEMPOTENT.rerun.info: Not applicable: there is no reconciliation job in this repository.

SELF-TRANSFER-REFUSED.is_refused.info: CoreTransfer loads the same wallet twice (service/transfer.go:20, service/transfer.go:24) and never compares the two ids.

SPLIT-SUMS-TO-TOTAL.remainder.info: Nobody: Fee returns amount / 100 and drops the remainder (service/transfer.go:97).

TRANSFER-IS-ATOMIC.same_transaction.info: The debit and the credit are separate UpdateBalance calls with Settle between them and no transaction around them (service/transfer.go:33, service/transfer.go:37, service/transfer.go:41).

TRANSFER-IS-ATOMIC.async_leg.info: Settle hands the source wallet to another system between the two legs (service/transfer.go:37); its implementation is not in this repository.

UNCLASSIFIED-ERROR-NOT-RETRIED.default.info: Every error is returned as is; nothing retries (service/transfer.go:37).

WALLET-STATUS-GATES-MOVEMENT.blocks_cred.info: That is the rule; Deposit and CoreTransfer never check status, only Withdraw does (service/transfer.go:71).

WEBHOOK-ORDER-INDEPENDENT.out_of_order.info: Not applicable: there are no provider callbacks in this repository.

technique.concurrency.contended.info: The balance of one wallet id: concurrent deposits read it (service/transfer.go:45) and write it back (service/transfer.go:58).

technique.faultInjection.observable.info: The balance a fake WalletRepository holds for each wallet id, and the Transaction rows it was asked to insert (repo/wallet.go:10).

technique.fuzz.valid_input.info: An existing wallet id and any Amount; nothing validates the amount (service/transfer.go:18, service/transfer.go:44).

technique.metamorphic.relation.info: One transfer of A+B and two transfers of A then B between the same wallets must leave the same two balances (service/transfer.go:17).

technique.narrowIntegration.real_depende.info: Postgres must be real for repo.Store (repo/wallet.go:23); the Notifier can be faked (repo/wallet.go:19).

technique.property.bounds.info: An amount should be positive and below 2^53 for the float conversion (service/transfer.go:18); today zero and negative amounts are accepted.

technique.stateMachine.driver.info: EnableWallet and DeleteWallet with a wallet id (service/transfer.go:79, service/transfer.go:88), over any WalletRepository.

technique.table.boundaries.info: Amounts 0, 1, 99, 100 and 101 for Fee (service/transfer.go:97), a balance equal to the amount for the funds check (service/transfer.go:29), and a deposit landing exactly on max_balance (service/transfer.go:54).
